identity: A worn leather shoulder bag on a cross-body strap: the strap runs from the far shoulder down across the chest to rest against the near hip, where the bag itself hangs. Free-drawn against the reference body — it hangs clear of the skin rather than fitting it, so the same shape reads fine on either body.

regions.note: cross-body strap, far shoulder to near hip. All free vertices.
bag body, hangs at the near hip where the strap ends.
